facts.fact: ANTIM states that SNISI integrates the tools of separate NGO-funded collection systems (nutrition, blindness, reproductive health, malaria, community mortality) into one common database with unified data transmission, a single user directory and unified access to each project's data, and says it allows cross-project analysis; no figures given.
